findings.bug: Resolver loads only the entry/shot import closure. Modules listed in project.modules with missing paths, bad versions, or cycles that are not reachable from the selected entry never fail validate/compile.

findings.fix_hint: On non-shot validate (and --all-shots), either resolve every listed module path for existence/version/containment or document and test that only closure integrity is guaranteed.
